title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: updated workspace memory in Copilot Workspaces
summary: The briefing passes: its planned behaviour and dates match the roadmap, and its background claims about Copilot memory match Microsoft Learn. Searches did not establish workspace-memory-specific defaults or controls; the licensing field should acknowledge the published product-level entitlement while preserving the narrower feature-specific gap.

claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. Replace licensing.notes with: 'Microsoft Copilot is available with Microsoft 365 E7 or as an add-on for eligible commercial, US Government, and education subscription plans. Microsoft has not published a licence requirement specific to workspace memory.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/plan/copilot-license-options. In Cost and licensing, replace the sentence ending 'so the licensing model stays "Not yet published"' with those same two sentences; retain the narrower unpublished workspace-memory meter and rate statement.
